showcase.query: something that feels really high-end and indulgent
showcase.why: The query is phrased in shopper language ('high-end and indulgent') that the cheap phone case literally quotes, so dense search ranks the phone case first. The luxury anchors carry BOTH registers — 'cashmere, silk and satin' and 'high-end and indulgent' — bridging the query to the cashmere wrap that never uses the query's words.
